sections.Profile:
The "Old Faithful" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1949, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Landmark, America, Single Player, Nature, Wood Rail, Original Theme
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Harry Mabs
- Art: Roy Parker
